title: Within reach
description: Six drawing tools unfold around a fixed point on a spare drafting surface.
useCase: Offer a small, spatially stable set of tools close to the area of work in a drawing or annotation interface.
interaction: Choose a tool, reopen the dial, or use arrow keys and Escape
reducedMotion: Tools appear and disappear in their final positions. Keyboard opening, navigation and selection are immediate.
limitations: Demonstrates local tool selection. It does not implement a drawing engine, viewport-edge repositioning, nested menus or a drag-to-select marking gesture.
look: Pale grey dot-grid drafting surface with a circular dial of six line icons around a black centre button, plus orange-red accents and a tilted frame.
motion: Pressing the centre button fans six tools outward from a 40 px to 93 px radius over 200 ms (expo-out) as they fade in; closing hides them at once.
adapt: Positions come from `angle` (60° steps) in `tools.map`, with the radius switching between 93 and 40 on `open`; easing is the `sf-radial-tool` transition. Replace `tools` and `glyphs`, and connect `setSelected` to your tool state.
